title: Avani Lekhara shooting event
subject: History
caption: Avani Lekhara competing in the 10 m air rifle standing event at Tokyo 2020 Paralympics.
altText: A photorealistic educational textbook illustration on a white background showing Indian Paralympic shooter Avani Lekhara seated in her sports wheelchair, standing posture, holding a 10 m air rifle with both hands, aiming at a target board placed 10 meters away. The target displays concentric scoring rings. A digital scoreboard beside the target shows her current score. The Paralympic rings are visible in the background. All components are clearly labelled: "Avani Lekhara", "Sports wheelchair", "Air rifle", "Target", "Scoreboard", "Paralympic emblem". The image is high resolution and accurately represents the equipment and setting of the Tokyo 2020 Paralympic shooting event.
